name: reconcile_pending
description: A provider-truth check whose gateway says the intent is alive and undecided - an unopened checkout, a payment still in flight, an e-NACH the bank is still approving. Same code the passive poll returns, deliberately: the caller polls or re-checks, and it must NOT be routed at a retry, which would open a second gateway object alongside a live one. TOKEN-SHAPED (plan-09 §0.4): the live intent is re-served as pay_page_token + pay_origin_digest so the customer can simply finish paying on the admin-hosted pay page; no raw gateway handle crosses the wire.
